findings.message: `datetime.now()` returns a naive local time. The previous code compared against `datetime.now(UTC)`, so `expires_at` is timezone-aware, and Python raises `TypeError` when comparing naive and aware datetimes. Every reset-token check will crash. Even with a naive `expires_at`, local time drifts from the UTC expiry by the server's offset and across DST changes, so tokens would expire early or late.
